sources.title: The paradox of intragroup conflict: A meta-analysis

sources.claim_limit: 642 experimental tests; pooled d=.36. Bias sensitivity differed: trim-and-fill d=.35 versus robust Bayesian model averaging d=.15 (interval .08–.22). sources.reuse: Accepted manuscript says it is not the copy of record. No open reuse licence verified. Link and short original synthesis only.
